Before you ask.

How much does a full apartment renovation cost in Dubai?

It depends on size and finish level. Most full apartment renovations we deliver start from AED 100,000, with premium and luxury scopes going beyond that. After a site visit you receive a detailed, fixed-scope quotation, never vague per-day pricing.

How long does it take?

A typical full apartment renovation runs 6 to 10 weeks depending on scope and building approvals. Your project manager gives you a timeline before work starts and weekly updates throughout.

Do you handle building management NOCs?

Yes. Drawings, building management approvals and developer NOCs are part of our scope. You don't chase anyone yourself.

Can I live in my apartment during the renovation?

For full renovations we recommend relocating temporarily. It's faster, safer and more comfortable. Your project manager will advise based on your scope.

Do you take on small jobs like painting or single-room work?

No. We focus on full renovations only, which is how we keep dedicated crews and consistent quality on every project.

Is there a warranty?

Yes. Our workmanship is covered by warranty, and we return to resolve any snags after handover.
